adversaries.name: Road Bandits
adversaries.description: Hungry people with weapons and a practiced formation.

tells.strike: A bandit raises his blade and approaches without looking away.
tells.brace: The leader shelters behind a road sign, keeping his knife ready for a short reply.
tells.heavy: He lifts his blade high and plants both feet. The committed blow will be difficult to catch but leaves room to sidestep.
tells.recover: His blade drags low after the swing. His chest is briefly open.

adversaries.name: Feral Dogs
adversaries.description: A scarred pack defending a wide hunting ground.

tells.strike: The lead dog comes low, watching your weapon hand.
tells.heavy: The largest dog sinks onto its haunches. Its whole body gathers for a lunge that would crush a weak guard.
tells.recover: The dog skids past and scrambles to turn. Its flank is unprotected.

adversaries.name: Ash Stalker
adversaries.description: A pale predator that hunts by vibration and copied sound.

tells.strike: The Stalker tilts its head toward your breathing. One hooked forelimb reaches forward.
tells.heavy: Its claws stop scraping. The hind legs fold under a gathering mass that no casual guard will hold.
tells.sweep: It flattens its limbs and spreads across the ground, threatening every direction of escape.
tells.recover: The creature settles after its rush, claws sunk too deeply to withdraw at once.

prediction.description: It learns repeated actions. A third identical action draws its announced counter; anything else breaks the pattern.

objective.text: Never repeat yourself thrice. Vary attacks, guards, and item play to stay unreadable.

adversaries.name: Toll Gang
adversaries.description: Extortionists who mistake uniforms for legitimacy.

tells.brace: The collectors close ranks behind their barricade, clubs held for short defensive blows.
tells.strike: A collector steps past the barrier, revolver tracking you.
tells.heavy: Their largest enforcer raises a club with both hands. It will strike one place with all his weight.
tells.recover: The enforcer struggles to lift the fallen club, leaving the line untidy.

adversaries.name: Marsh Leeches
adversaries.description: Hand-long parasites disturbed by warm water.

tells.sweep: The water wrinkles all around you. Small bodies spread across every place you could step.
tells.strike: The nearest parasites rear toward the warmth of your legs.
tells.recover: The feeding mass draws together again, exposing a moment of stillness.

adversaries.name: Bog Raiders
adversaries.description: Masked skiff riders who know every dry patch.
adversaries.field_note: Two riders back to back; heron mask and one red eye; pole-hook and patched shotgun.

tells.strike: The nearest raider shoulders a patched gun and sights along the barrel.
tells.sweep: The skiff turns broadside. Several barrels fan across the narrow bank together.
tells.brace: The raiders crouch behind the skiff's plated rim, keeping short bursts aimed at your position.

adversaries.name: Security Drones
adversaries.description: Failing machines still obey an evacuation order.

tells.strike: Red targeting lights steady on your chest as the drones drift apart.
tells.charge: Emitter coils rise in pitch. A much stronger discharge is building.
tells.heavy: The charged emitters converge. Their narrow line promises an impact too powerful to meet casually.
tells.recover: The emitters dim and their cooling vents open, exposing the mechanisms beneath.

adversaries.name: Vault Scavengers
adversaries.description: A disciplined crew protecting its claim.
adversaries.field_note: Four claimants at rest; charcoal crop and silver forelock; weapons down, eyes up.

tells.brace: The crew closes behind a slab of salvage. An axe waits over its edge.
tells.strike: A rifle comes over the slab and follows your movement.
tells.heavy: An axeman steps into the open and draws the tool far behind him. The blow needs space and momentum.
tells.recover: The axe bites the ground. Its owner must wrench it free before defending himself.

adversaries.name: Glass Cult
adversaries.description: Pilgrims who treat radiation burns as revelation.
adversaries.field_note: Five pilgrims in road cloth; veiled leader, tired eyes; burns worn as rank.

tells.strike: A pilgrim draws a glass edge across the light and advances.
tells.sweep: The pilgrims spread their blades into a glittering arc, narrowing the ground you can dodge into.
tells.heavy: Their champion raises a long shard overhead. His weight shifts completely into the coming thrust.
tells.recover: The shard trembles low after the thrust, leaving its bearer unbalanced.

adversaries.name: Tunnel Hunters
adversaries.description: Silent raiders using darkness as armor.
adversaries.field_note: Bound locs and wrapped braid; green-stained jaws; wrapped dark that listens.

tells.strike: A knife catches the tunnel light. Its owner is already moving toward you.
tells.heavy: A hunter springs from the wall with both knives forward. The leap has power but little room to turn.
tells.brace: The hunters withdraw behind a support pillar, blades waiting close to its edge.

adversaries.name: Citadel Guard
adversaries.description: Well-fed soldiers defending the last clean walls.
adversaries.field_note: Blunt bob and mustache; maintained kit, clean walls; rifles at rest, eyes forward.

tells.brace: The guards close their shields, rifle muzzles resting in the gaps.
tells.strike: A rifle swings into a clean firing line.
tells.charge: The squad settles into a firing stance. You hear the order to prepare a concentrated volley.
tells.heavy: Every barrel fixes on one patch of ground. The volley is about to arrive with overwhelming force.
tells.recover: The rifles fall quiet for reloads. Armor shifts apart around busy hands.

adversaries.name: Warden Machine
adversaries.description: An armored checkpoint intelligence with no surrender protocol.

tells.charge: The Warden's rotary cannon accelerates. Warning lights trace the narrow lane it is preparing to erase.
tells.heavy: The cannon locks onto your position. Standing behind a weak guard will not stop the concentrated burst.
tells.recover: Cooling fins unfold along the silent cannon. For a moment its exposed mechanisms cannot answer.
tells.sweep: The cannon turns sideways, sweeping its firing line across the available ground.

adversaries.name: Mutant Crows
adversaries.description: Hairless scavengers that attack as one shrieking cloud.

tells.strike: The nearest crows pitch forward, beaks pointing at your hands.
tells.sweep: The flock spreads across your path, wings closing off either side.
tells.recover: The birds circle beyond reach, struggling to regroup.

adversaries.name: Reed Widow
adversaries.description: A predator under a raft of living reeds, waiting for weight.

tells.brace: The raft settles lower and the lights go out under it, and packed reed will take half of whatever you land on it.
tells.strike: Reeds part where nothing showed a moment ago, opening on the foot you have your weight on.
tells.heavy: It takes hold and pulls toward deep water, tilting the whole raft behind a commitment no guard will hold but a sidestep can leave behind.
tells.recover: It surfaces to breathe, eggs exposed along its back and nothing covering the length of it.

brood.description: A heavy pull gathers the brood. Interrupt it, burn the nest, or finish it quickly.

objective.text: Brood 0/3 • Interrupt its preparation, burn the nest with an incendiary, or kill it before the brood hatches.

adversaries.field_note: Reed raft over water; pale eggs in sequence; one laced boot.

adversaries.name: Kilnback
adversaries.description: A heat-seeking mass that breathes on the tank's pressure cycle.

tells.brace: It draws the plates in until nothing shows but scorched metal, and the stack will take half of whatever you land on it.
tells.heavy: The whole mass rocks back against the tank wall, gathering weight no guard will hold behind a line you can still step out of.
tells.strike: One plate edge comes out at knee height, moving faster than the mass behind it.
tells.recover: It sags, plates loosening and heat pouring off it, with nothing holding the gaps closed.

heat.description: Your attacks heat its shell. At full heat the shell opens: defend through the danger, then spend your strongest blow.

objective.text: Heat 0/3 • Attacks build heat and danger. At full heat the shell opens for 2 rounds. Coolant forces it open early.

adversaries.field_note: Stacked plates around a heat; scorch-rings on the tank; three knocks and a pause.

adversaries.name: Shutter Skitters
adversaries.description: Flat plated animals that shelter together inside warm apartment walls.

tells.sweep: Plates fan out across the landing, closing off the stair on both sides.
tells.strike: The nearest bodies rear toward the warmth of your shins.
tells.brace: The colony locks together into one armored sheet, taking half of whatever you land on it.
tells.recover: The sheet comes apart into scattered bodies looking for the wall.

adversaries.field_note: Plated colony; roof-slate bodies; the tapping in the wall.

adversaries.name: Cable Eater
adversaries.description: A segmented organism that bridges severed power lines to feed on their current.

tells.charge: The lights along the run brighten all at once; it is drawing the load.
tells.strike: A segment snaps out of the tray toward your hands.
tells.sweep: It lashes the length of the tray at knee height.
tells.brace: It coils around the live cable and goes still, taking half of whatever you land on it.
tells.recover: It uncoils to find the next span, segments dragging.

charge.description: Its electrical strikes charge a retaliation. Disrupt its draw, ground the cable, or wear grounding gear.

objective.text: Charge 0/3 • Strikes feed it. Disrupt the draw, ground the cable bare-handed, or kill it fast.

adversaries.field_note: Segmented body in the cable tray; shed insulation on the water; the lights dimming in sequence.

adversaries.name: Pox Dogs
adversaries.description: Feral dogs swollen with pale cysts that burst into spore clouds.

tells.strike: The lead pox dog lowers its swollen head, cysts pulsing along its neck.
tells.sweep: The pack fans across the ground, weeping flanks turned toward every escape.
tells.recover: The dogs fall back to snap at their own sores, tongues working the burst skin.

adversaries.field_note: Swollen flanks; pale cysts; a cough like wet paper tearing.

adversaries.name: Bile Spewer
adversaries.description: A bloated marsh floater that vomits gut-dissolving bile at warm bodies.

tells.strike: The spewer's throat swells and its mouth opens on black bile.
tells.heavy: Its whole gut contracts at once, gathering a flood no guard will hold but a sidestep can leave behind.
tells.brace: It sinks low and seals its folds, taking half of whatever you land on it.
tells.recover: It sags emptied, tendrils trailing, with nothing covering its raw mouth.

adversaries.field_note: Bloated floater; black bile stains; the smell reaches you first.

adversaries.name: Cinder Mauler
adversaries.description: A furnace-scarred brute plated in half-melted scrap, still smoking.

tells.strike: The mauler drags one smoking fist forward, heat rippling off the plates.
tells.heavy: It draws both fists high together, gathering furnace weight no guard will hold behind a line you can still step out of.
tells.brace: It locks its plates edge to edge, taking half of whatever you land on it.
tells.recover: Steam bursts from its seams as it cools, plates gaping open around the joints.

adversaries.field_note: Half-melted plates; smoking seams; footprints of cooling slag.

adversaries.name: Salt Colossus
adversaries.description: A towering mutant fused with crawler armor, worshipped and feared by the wastes.

tells.charge: The colossus plants both feet and draws a breath that moves the dust. Something enormous is gathering.
tells.heavy: Both avalanche fists rise together against the sky. The coming blow will erase whatever ground you stand on.
tells.sweep: It turns sideways and swings one plated arm across the whole approach, closing every sideways route.
tells.recover: It kneels in its own crater, armor fallen open, breathing through exposed red gaps.

adversaries.field_note: Crawler armor fused to flesh; crater footsteps; pilgrim offerings at its trail.

adversaries.name: Reservoir Maw
adversaries.description: A filtration-station mutant grown around the intake screens, still thirsty.

tells.strike: A pale intake plate swings out of the dark water toward your legs.
tells.charge: The whole chamber gurgles and the waterline climbs the wall marks. A surge is gathering.
tells.heavy: It seals the outflow and throws its weight behind the rising water, a blow no guard will hold but a sidestep can leave behind.
tells.sweep: It turns the full width of the chamber, closing every dry line at once.
tells.recover: It vents and settles, screens gaping, with nothing covering the raw intake.

flood.description: Its surges flood the chamber. At full water the response hits hardest. Two drainage wheels can empty it.

objective.text: Water 0/3 • Drains 0/2 • Kill it, or work both wheels and slip the channel.

adversaries.field_note: Intake screens grown into flesh; twin wheel-valves above the waterline; boot-prints ending at the edge.

adversaries.name: Ossuary Hound
adversaries.description: A scavenger with bone plates embedded in scarred hide, still hunting.

tells.strike: The hound lowers its plated head, scarred flanks heaving, and comes straight on.
tells.heavy: It gathers its hindquarters under the bone plates. The coming lunge will carry everything it has.
tells.sweep: It circles wide, plates scraping, cutting off the ground you wanted.
tells.recover: It falls back to worry at its own seams, flesh visibly knitting under the plates.

bleed.description: It scents bleeding survivors and knits itself on recover. Treat the blood, or stop the knitting with silver or cautery.

objective.text: Bleeding draws it (+30%). It heals 12 on recover unless a silvered Riposte or cautery stops it.

adversaries.field_note: Bone plates over scarred hide; old blood darkening the muzzle; tracks that pause to sniff.
